description: Fixed host-managed SVG creation, unchanged native raster publication and independent same-source bitmap style variants.

requires.shell: POSIX sh, jq >=1.6, xmllint, cmp, shasum and standard Unix utilities
requires.bitmap: Unchanged bitmap-stylizer; separately installed reviewed BITMAP_HELPER built with Go >=1.22 and selected BITMAP_GENERATOR
requires.models: Explicit VECTOR_STYLE_MODEL and BITMAP_AUTHOR_MODEL; inherited AGENT_ASK/PRESENT_ASK preserved
requires.boundary: Caller-owned host entry bin/studio, default Cage for child Agent actions, trusted definitions/tools outside runs
requires.review: Deterministic acceptance only; caller must review actual baseline and variants full-size and thumbnail
